title: Appointment SMS and email notifications
summary: The SMS and email messages the platform sends to customers about their appointments, when each is sent, and the retry and sender settings behind them.
bodyMd:
The platform sends customers a series of SMS and email messages from booking through to check-in. The templates are listed under Platform Admin → Enabled Features → Queueing / Appointments → Shared Settings, each with a Last Updated date, its Number of Characters and an SMS Enabled or Email Enabled toggle.

Message templates

TemplateSMSEmailWhen it is sent
Appointments - Click Link to ConfirmYesYesWhen a booking is made. The customer must open the link within the template's Time to Click to Confirm their Appointment window (default 5 minutes).
Appointments - ConfirmationYesYesWhen the customer confirms the booking.
Appointments - ReminderYesYesAt the template's Send SMS Reminder to a Customer time (default 24 hours before the appointment).
Appointments - Check InYesNoWhen the customer checks in on arrival.
Appointments - Picked up by StaffYesNoWhen a staff member picks up the customer for their appointment.
Appointments - Updated by StaffYesYesWhen staff change the appointment from Retail Admin.
Appointments - RescheduledYesYesWhen the appointment is moved to a new time.
Appointments - No ShowYesNoWhen the customer is marked as a no show.
Appointments - CancelledYesYesWhen the appointment is cancelled.
Appointments - Click & CollectYesYesFor click-and-collect bookings.

The same page lists the 3 queueing SMS templates (Queueing - Join the Queue, Queueing- It's Your Turn, Queueing - Lost Your Spot); see SMS and email messages sent to visitors.

Delivery settings

SettingDefaultWhere
SMS sender${BrandName}Platform SMS Sender ID (AWS SES SMS/Text) under Company Settings → Platform Set-up. See Update the platform's SMS sender ID.
Email sender address—Platform Email address (AWS SES Email), which must show Verified, under Company Settings → Platform Set-up.
Email sender name${BrandName}Email Sender Name (From) under Company Settings → Platform Set-up.
SMS Max Retry2 timesAppointment Template → MESSAGE SENDING SETTINGS.
SMS Retry Interval30 secondsAppointment Template → MESSAGE SENDING SETTINGS.
Email Retry Interval30 secondsAppointment Template → MESSAGE SENDING SETTINGS.
AWS SES RegionUS East (N. Virginia)Company Settings → Platform Set-up.

Messages are delivered through Amazon Simple Email Service (SES). SMS and email sending must be approved in your AWS account, and some sender IDs are restricted; a restricted sender ID means no SMS is sent. See SMS messages are not sent or arrive as UNVERIFIED.
